proposals.title: Require same-session physical NPU ownership proof for every A/B arm
proposals.evidence: A diagnostic baseline completed while a pre-existing NPU0-3 vLLM workload was later found; the candidate then failed device inspection.
proposals.proposal: Before baseline and candidate separately, record host npu-smi process ownership, container host-to-container device maps, ports, and HBM. Invalidate the arm if exclusivity is not proven.

proposals.title: Separate algorithm savings from routing and serving overhead
proposals.evidence: Dynamic MoE reduced expert work and sped up expert GMM, yet routing overhead caused an 82-96% whole-block regression; Prefix Cache also regressed its real traffic shape.
proposals.proposal: Require end-to-end repeated A/B plus stage profiling before accepting a paper optimization, even when a microkernel or compute-count metric improves.

proposals.title: Classify invalid and failed runs without erasing them
proposals.evidence: The MTP baseline is useful diagnostic evidence but cannot support a decision because resource isolation failed.
proposals.proposal: Handoffs should retain paths and observed numbers while marking validity, failure phase, safety action, and exact rerun gate.
